messages:
deploybot: Promotion to staging failed: artifact-index lock timeout (409). Promotion for build 2024.03.09-17 is stuck. Auto-retry scheduled in 30s.

maria: hmm, I saw a bunch of 409s during the manifest push earlier. any idea which service is holding the lock?

simon: looks like the indexing job on staging-node-3 got OOM killed earlier. log snippet: `indexer: panic: runtime: out of memory` then it restarted. might not have released the lease.

anya: we had a partial write from the reindexer earlier this morning. maybe the indexer left a stale lease. Can SRE force-release it?

sre-oncall: on it. checking lease table now. if it's stale we can rm the lease entry, but that can cause a brief read inconsistency for in-flight reads.

maria: tradeoff is between forcing the release vs waiting for the reindexer to finish (which could be ~10m). we have a change window at +30m. what's the impact if we wait?

simon: waiting delays this promotion and blocks downstream canary jobs. If we wait >15m we miss today's small-batch window.

ci-bot: Canary job queued: canary-2024.03.09-17 awaiting artifact promotion. Timeout for canary queue = 45m.

anya: I prefer to force-release and re-run a quick indexer job after promote. rollback plan if things go weird: revert to build 2024.03.09-16 (last-good).

maria: agree with force-release + post-promote indexer run. but we should pin the DB migration version and add a quick smoke after promote.

sre-oncall: I can remove the lease now. executing: `DELETE FROM index_leases WHERE key = 'staging-artifact-index-3' AND lease_ts < 1707770000`

deploybot: Manual intervention detected. Promotion retriggered by @maria. Starting artifact push for build 2024.03.09-17.

maria: running post-promote smoke: `curl -sS https://staging/api/health || true`

simon: smoke ok for basic endpoints, but I'll run a subset of integration checks against the new index.

anya: if the smoke fails, we roll back to 2024.03.09-16 via the normal rollback workflow. who will own the rollback?

maria: I'll own rollback if needed. Simon will do the pre-rollback verification. SRE will stand by for DB/lease ops.

ci-bot: Promote completed: artifact 2024.03.09-17 -> staging. canary queued (job id 2345).

simon: starting integration checks now. tailing logs: `indexer: reindex started; shards repaired: 0/24`

maria: good call to pin migration version. please add the pinned version to the release note: "Pinned DB migration v12 for staging promote 2024.03.09-17"

anya: test run green for the subset (auth/login, search basic). I'm going to run a few more queries that hit the repaired shards.

sre-oncall: left a note in the incident log: "Forced lease delete to unblock promotion; follow-up: add lease TTL/cleanup to indexer restart path"

maria: summary: forced lease delete to unblock promotion, promoted build 2024.03.09-17, pin migration v12, post-promote indexer run in progress, rollback owner = maria if regressions observed. I'll update the release notes and queue a tiny rollback-runbook in the release ticket. :white_check_mark:
